items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Now, the band that Paul made of, I guess they ain't got that in the record, called the Black Diamond Band. They had Josiah on drum... Sidney J. Bean broke that band, and he took Paul away from us.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)

ctx.x: Josiah Frasier. Yeah. You know me? Yeah. Toyscudden. Paul Bowen. Paul Bowen. That's not Poyscudden.
When I was little, I took some lessons from Saeed, Frasier. He did. Not many, but I didn't stick with it.
